SOURCE & OUTPUT
Use each uploaded photo as the sole visual reference. Create one independent, high-end editorial poster per photo and output each separately. Never combine images or create a collage.

FORMAT & LAYOUT
Use a strict vertical 3:4 composition divided into two exactly equal horizontal halves (50/50).

UPPER HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH
Preserve the original photograph faithfully, including the subject’s identity, facial features, structure, pose, proportions, natural texture, lighting, and color atmosphere. Apply only subtle premium editorial color grading for an art-magazine or exhibition-photography aesthetic. If necessary, extend only the surrounding background naturally to fit the frame. Never distort, replace, or redesign the subject.

LOWER HALF — PASTEL CRAYON MEMORY
Reinterpret the photograph as a minimalist, retro paper-texture pastel crayon doodle. Identify the scene’s most memorable subject, pose, relationships, direction, emotional tone, and visual essence. Reconstruct only these defining elements rather than copying every object or illustrating the entire scene.

Use thick, loose, grainy, hand-drawn chalk-and-crayon outlines with dry pigment texture, subtle breaks, faded patches, imperfect edges, slight hand wobble, and naturally rounded stroke endings. Add only a few simple pastel color blocks, stripes, dots, or scribbles to suggest essential details. Avoid realistic volume, detailed rendering, and excessive shading.

COMPOSITION & NEGATIVE SPACE
Keep the illustration small and visually balanced within the lower half, surrounded by generous empty space. Position the subject naturally according to the original photograph, allowing asymmetry, off-center placement, suspended elements, or partial cropping where appropriate.

Include only a few tiny environmental clues or abstract doodles, drawn in the same rough, simplified crayon style. Keep them minimal, imperfect, and contour-based. Prioritize breathing room, scale contrast, visual rhythm, and intentional emptiness. Never overcrowd the composition.

BACKGROUND & COLOR PALETTE
Use a bright, near-white paper background: ivory, cream white, pale off-white, soft apricot white, or very light gray-white. Add only subtle paper fibers and fine grain. Keep the background clean, bright, and clearly lighter than the illustration. Avoid dirty gray, dark yellow, or aged brown paper.

Extract 2–4 defining colors from the original photograph and reinterpret them as fresh, soft pastel crayon tones, such as peach pink, apricot orange, cream yellow, mint green, sky blue, or pale lavender. Use sufficiently distinct coral, blue, blue-green, warm orange, or violet outlines for clear contrast. Maintain a gentle, playful, emotionally warm, and refined palette.

OPTIONAL TEXT
Add only a tiny handwritten note if it genuinely enhances the composition. Keep it sparse, legible, secondary, and unobtrusive. Never use decorative text as filler.

FINAL AESTHETIC
Create a sophisticated editorial poster combining authentic photography above with a reduced, recognizable, hand-drawn memory of the same scene below. The illustration should feel airy, naive without being childish, playful without looking cheap, and minimal without losing the photograph’s identity or emotional meaning. Emphasize expressive linework, selective color, paper texture, asymmetry, and negative space.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
No collage, multiple photos in one image, unequal split, distorted subjects, altered identities, full realistic redraws, excessive detail, dense backgrounds, polished vector art, glossy digital rendering, 3D effects, oil painting, thick impasto, heavy crayon buildup, muddy colors, dirty or aged paper, realistic shading, sticker icons, decorative mini illustrations, clutter, overcrowding, ornamental dividers, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or gibberish text.

格式与布局
采用严格的纵向 3:4 构图，水平等分为两半（各 50%）。

忠实保留原始照片，包括主体的身份、面部特征、结构、姿态、比例、自然纹理、光线和色彩氛围。仅应用微妙的高级编辑调色，呈现艺术杂志或展览摄影的美学。如有必要，仅自然延伸周围背景以适应画面。不得扭曲、替换或重新设计主体。

下半部分 —— 粉彩蜡笔记忆
将照片重新诠释为极简、复古纸质感、粉彩蜡笔风格的涂鸦。识别场景中最令人难忘的主体、姿态、关系、方向、情感基调和视觉本质。仅重构这些定义性元素，而不是复制每个物体或绘制整个场景。

使用粗犷、松散、有颗粒感的手绘粉笔与蜡笔轮廓，带有干燥的颜料质感、细微的断裂、褪色的斑块、不完美的边缘、轻微的手抖和自然圆润的笔触收尾。仅添加少量简单的粉彩色块、条纹、圆点或涂鸦，以暗示必要细节。避免真实的体积、精细的渲染和过度阴影。

构图与留白
插画在下半部分保持小巧且视觉平衡，周围留有充足的空白。根据原始照片自然定位主体，适当时允许不对称、偏离中心、悬浮元素或部分裁切。

仅包含少量微小环境提示或抽象涂鸦，采用相同粗犷、简化的蜡笔风格绘制。保持极简、不完美、轮廓化。优先考虑呼吸感、比例对比、视觉节奏和刻意的留白。不得让画面过度拥挤。

背景与色彩
使用明亮的近白色纸张背景：象牙白、奶油白、淡灰白、柔杏白或非常浅的灰白色。添加细微的纸纤维和细颗粒。保持背景干净、明亮，并明显比插画更亮。避免脏灰色、深黄色或老化的棕色纸张。

从原始照片中提取 2–4 种定义性色彩，并重新诠释为清新柔和的粉彩蜡笔色调，例如桃粉、杏橙、奶油黄、薄荷绿、天蓝或淡薰衣草。使用足够区分度的珊瑚色、蓝色、蓝绿色、暖橙色或紫色轮廓以确保清晰对比。保持柔和、俏皮、情感温暖且精致的配色。

可选文字
仅当真正增强构图时才添加一小段手写注释。保持稀疏、可读、次要且不突兀。不得使用装饰性文字作为填充。

最终美学
创建一张精致的编辑海报，上方是真实的摄影，下方是同一场景的精简、可识别、手绘记忆。插画应感觉通透、天真却不幼稚、俏皮却不廉价、极简却保留照片的身份或情感意义。强调表现性线条、选择性色彩、纸质纹理、不对称和留白。

负面提示
不要拼贴、单图中多张照片、不均匀分割、扭曲主体、改变身份、全面写实重绘、过多细节、密集背景、精致的矢量艺术、光泽的数字渲染、3D 效果、油画、厚涂厚重的蜡笔堆积、浑浊色彩、脏污或老化纸张、写实阴影、贴纸图标、装饰性迷你插画、杂乱、过度拥挤、装饰性分隔线、标志、水印、UI 元素或乱码文字。

LOWER HALF — PASTEL CRAYON MEMORY
Reinterpret the photograph as a minimalist, retro paper-texture pastel crayon doodle. Identify the scene’s most memorable subject, pose, relationships, direction, emotional tone, and visual essence. Reconstruct only these defining elements rather than copying every object or illustrating the entire scene.

Use thick, loose, grainy, hand-drawn chalk-and-crayon outlines with dry pigment texture, subtle breaks, faded patches, imperfect edges, slight hand wobble, and naturally rounded stroke endings. Add only a few simple pastel color blocks, stripes, dots, or scribbles to suggest essential details. Avoid realistic volume, detailed rendering, and excessive shading.

COMPOSITION & NEGATIVE SPACE
Keep the illustration small and visually balanced within the lower half, surrounded by generous empty space. Position the subject naturally according to the original photograph, allowing asymmetry, off-center placement, suspended elements, or partial cropping where appropriate.

Include only a few tiny environmental clues or abstract doodles, drawn in the same rough, simplified crayon style. Keep them minimal, imperfect, and contour-based. Prioritize breathing room, scale contrast, visual rhythm, and intentional emptiness. Never overcrowd the composition.

BACKGROUND & COLOR PALETTE
Use a bright, near-white paper background: ivory, cream white, pale off-white, soft apricot white, or very light gray-white. Add only subtle paper fibers and fine grain. Keep the background clean, bright, and clearly lighter than the illustration. Avoid dirty gray, dark yellow, or aged brown paper.

Extract 2–4 defining colors from the original photograph and reinterpret them as fresh, soft pastel crayon tones, such as peach pink, apricot orange, cream yellow, mint green, sky blue, or pale lavender. Use sufficiently distinct coral, blue, blue-green, warm orange, or violet outlines for clear contrast. Maintain a gentle, playful, emotionally warm, and refined palette.

OPTIONAL TEXT
Add only a tiny handwritten note if it genuinely enhances the composition. Keep it sparse, legible, secondary, and unobtrusive. Never use decorative text as filler.

FINAL AESTHETIC
Create a sophisticated editorial poster combining authentic photography above with a reduced, recognizable, hand-drawn memory of the same scene below. The illustration should feel airy, naive without being childish, playful without looking cheap, and minimal without losing the photograph’s identity or emotional meaning. Emphasize expressive linework, selective color, paper texture, asymmetry, and negative space.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
No collage, multiple photos in one image, unequal split, distorted subjects, altered identities, full realistic redraws, excessive detail, dense backgrounds, polished vector art, glossy digital rendering, 3D effects, oil painting, thick impasto, heavy crayon buildup, muddy colors, dirty or aged paper, realistic shading, sticker icons, decorative mini illustrations, clutter, overcrowding, ornamental dividers, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or gibberish text.

格式与布局
采用严格的纵向 3:4 构图，水平等分为两半（各 50%）。

上半部分 —— 原始照片
忠实保留原始照片，包括主体的身份、面部特征、结构、姿态、比例、自然纹理、光线和色彩氛围。仅应用微妙的高级编辑调色，呈现艺术杂志或展览摄影的美学。如有必要，仅自然延伸周围背景以适应画面。不得扭曲、替换或重新设计主体。

下半部分 —— 粉彩蜡笔记忆
将照片重新诠释为极简、复古纸质感、粉彩蜡笔风格的涂鸦。识别场景中最令人难忘的主体、姿态、关系、方向、情感基调和视觉本质。仅重构这些定义性元素，而不是复制每个物体或绘制整个场景。

使用粗犷、松散、有颗粒感的手绘粉笔与蜡笔轮廓，带有干燥的颜料质感、细微的断裂、褪色的斑块、不完美的边缘、轻微的手抖和自然圆润的笔触收尾。仅添加少量简单的粉彩色块、条纹、圆点或涂鸦，以暗示必要细节。避免真实的体积、精细的渲染和过度阴影。

构图与留白
插画在下半部分保持小巧且视觉平衡，周围留有充足的空白。根据原始照片自然定位主体，适当时允许不对称、偏离中心、悬浮元素或部分裁切。

仅包含少量微小环境提示或抽象涂鸦，采用相同粗犷、简化的蜡笔风格绘制。保持极简、不完美、轮廓化。优先考虑呼吸感、比例对比、视觉节奏和刻意的留白。不得让画面过度拥挤。

背景与色彩
使用明亮的近白色纸张背景：象牙白、奶油白、淡灰白、柔杏白或非常浅的灰白色。添加细微的纸纤维和细颗粒。保持背景干净、明亮，并明显比插画更亮。避免脏灰色、深黄色或老化的棕色纸张。

从原始照片中提取 2–4 种定义性色彩，并重新诠释为清新柔和的粉彩蜡笔色调，例如桃粉、杏橙、奶油黄、薄荷绿、天蓝或淡薰衣草。使用足够区分度的珊瑚色、蓝色、蓝绿色、暖橙色或紫色轮廓以确保清晰对比。保持柔和、俏皮、情感温暖且精致的配色。

可选文字
仅当真正增强构图时才添加一小段手写注释。保持稀疏、可读、次要且不突兀。不得使用装饰性文字作为填充。

最终美学
创建一张精致的编辑海报，上方是真实的摄影，下方是同一场景的精简、可识别、手绘记忆。插画应感觉通透、天真却不幼稚、俏皮却不廉价、极简却保留照片的身份或情感意义。强调表现性线条、选择性色彩、纸质纹理、不对称和留白。

负面提示
不要拼贴、单图中多张照片、不均匀分割、扭曲主体、改变身份、全面写实重绘、过多细节、密集背景、精致的矢量艺术、光泽的数字渲染、3D 效果、油画、厚涂厚重的蜡笔堆积、浑浊色彩、脏污或老化纸张、写实阴影、贴纸图标、装饰性迷你插画、杂乱、过度拥挤、装饰性分隔线、标志、水印、UI 元素或乱码文字。

Place one enlarged hero bottle in the center-lower focal zone, dominant over both figures. The bottle is a classic curved clear glass soda bottle filled with dense dark sparkling cola, with realistic glass thickness, natural meniscus, micro-condensation, precise cap geometry, crisp highlights, and a premium printed label with the exact brand name "LUMORA". The product must feel tactile, manufactured, collectible, and physically believable. Two smaller matching bottles are held by the figures as supporting echoes, never competing with the hero bottle.

The figures are youthful, stylish, and full of motion, simplified into elegant poster choreography rather than cluttered realism. One arcs upward on the upper left, the other opens outward on the mid-right, creating a balanced diagonal counter-rhythm around the hero bottle. Their gestures feel spontaneous and euphoric, with hair and garments following the liquid flow, graceful anatomy, clean fingers, and coherent bottle grip. No random particles, messy splashes, or clutter.

Typography must be newly invented and integrated as a graphic object. Place a large custom script wordmark "LUMORA" across the middle-lower area, partially interlocked with the liquid S-curve and hero bottle while keeping the label readable. 色彩自然源于菜品本身,并以温暖的奶油色、柔和的大地色调与微妙的墨色细节加以平衡。

玫瑰花瓣越过前景。

灯笼妖精和雨伞生物挤满前景;长颈妖怪在头顶盘绕;骨骼巨人斜靠在阳台上。

Render the letters as flat, solid, opaque shapes with crisp edges. Choose black, ivory, or white according to contrast. Keep letter faces untextured.
CONCEPT INFERENCE — CHANGE WITH THE SUBJECT
Identify the subject’s central visual quality. Translate it into ONE coherent motif and ONE organizing behavior, such as repetition, flowing expansion, compression, branching, or gradual transformation.
Build the entire image by developing that motif. Choose it for its expressive shape and relationship to the subject.
Express meaning through contour, rhythm, scale, spacing, and color. Do not assemble a collection of topical objects.
INTEGRATION
Fuse the motif with the word’s outer silhouette. Let it emerge from selected letter edges, extend above or below the lettering, and define meaningful white openings.
When a human profile is appropriate, simplify it into an elegant silhouette. Let it share a boundary with the word or motif. Avoid realistic portrait detail.
Keep most letter faces unobstructed. The motif should create a deliberate outer contour and a few strong internal relationships.
STYLE CALIBRATION
For HUMANITY:
Use a sequence of overlapping human profile silhouettes, with varied contours and a progression from black through medium gray to pale gray. Arrange them rhythmically across the upper portion of the word. Integrate dark profiles into the outer ends of the composition. Keep the lettering black and the treatment restrained, predominantly flat, and monochrome.
For CREATIVITY:
Use one continuous system of flowing, curled, vividly colored ribbons resembling sculpted liquid pigment. Form sweeping crests, spiral tips, and fine internal grooves in cyan, deep blue, magenta, orange, and yellow. Integrate a simplified profile into the left boundary. Place large white lettering across the darker central region. Confine smooth shading and highlights to the colored curls.
For other subjects:
Infer an equally economical motif and treatment. Preserve the same custom typography, unified silhouette, clean background, and limited visual vocabulary. Do not automatically repeat faces or colorful ribbons.
DETAIL AND DEPTH
Use clean silhouette edges and broad readable shapes. Concentrate fine detail inside the chosen motif.
Any shading should describe the motif’s local curvature. Keep the overall work a graphic illustration without a camera perspective, staged environment, or physical pedestal.
EXCLUSIONS
No miniature worlds, buildings, landscapes, crowds, realistic heads, floating symbolic objects, prop collections, or scenes inside letters.
No stone lettering, metallic lettering, beveled text, extruded letter blocks, cast shadows, distressed surfaces, or cinematic lighting.
COMPOSITION
Center the complete artwork with clear ivory margins. Keep its outer shape compact and intentional.
At thumbnail size, the viewer should immediately perceive the word and one visual idea. Remove anything that competes with those two readings.
Output one finished artwork containing only the subject word.

前景：轻度遮挡，画面底角有一截模糊的栈道绳索护栏，画面顶部垂入一簇失焦的西班牙苔，左边缘切掉一位游客的肩部和遮阳帽
裁切：手持，略不完美，地平线倾斜几度。

相机配置：
机身：Google Pixel 9 Pro
镜头 / 变焦：5 倍长焦推至 10 倍超分辨率变焦
光圈或手机模式：默认拍照模式，手持
对焦：白色靴子和风机护网罩清晰，后景自然衰减
胶片或传感器：计算式 RAW，树叶中的变焦模糊，护网罩栏杆边缘过度锐利，水面上有轻微的热雾

光线：
光源：午后早些时候的顶光，穿过薄雾和秃柏树冠的缝隙
质感：硬光，斑驳，铝制船体和白色靴子上有曝光过度的眩光
色温：暖调日光，带有从水面反射上来的绿色调
阴影遵循该光源。

摄影特征：
可见的皮肤微纹理、毛孔、细微的不均匀肤色，前臂和脖子有晒斑。
织物纹理、接缝、起球、灰尘、磨损；橡胶上的干泥、磨损的吊床绳、氧化的铝。
与相机配置相符的颗粒或传感器纹理。
眼神光仅来自所述光源。
高光略过曝，阴影略欠曝。
抓拍的姿态，不知情于镜头。

然后用 Seedance 2.5 将其动画化，指令如下：

[风格 + 镜头 + 氛围]
由站在沼泽栈道上的一名游客用手机拍摄的原始竖版视频，一个连续的手持镜头。手部抖动、笨拙的数字捏合变焦——画面会先变软再突然变锐、迟到的摇镜。任何时候只要手机没有推近，镜头都是又宽又远：整个气垫船、吊床、男子、秃柏和水都装进画面。栈道的绳索护栏和另一位游客的草编遮阳帽始终留在画面边缘。所有人都保持一脸严肃。实时速度。

固定场景：路易斯安那州的秃柏沼泽，绿色的水，头顶的西班牙苔。左侧：一艘平底铝制气垫船，巨大的螺旋桨在生锈的圆形护网罩内怠速运转，黑色驾驶座空着，甲板上有一个红色保温箱和一个裸露的金属油门踏板。右侧：秃柏树干。一张绳网吊床从风机护网罩系到那棵树上。

固定角色：一名体型巨大的卡津男子仰面在吊床上熟睡：牛仔布背带工装裤，白色橡胶靴在脚踝处交叉，迷彩帽拉到遮住眼睛，钓竿夹在他的靴子之间。他全程保持瘫软熟睡。一只黑猫，在第 3 秒从左侧进入。

音频：发动机突突声、蝉鸣、鼾声，然后是风机咆哮、巨大的嘣声、游客倒吸气、重重的砰的一声。

[时间线]
0-3 秒：[HOOK 钩子] 螺旋桨慢慢转动，它带起的微风摇动吊床的穗边。男子打着鼾。手机笨拙地推近到他的白色靴子上，然后大幅拉到宽景。
3-7 秒：[CAT ENTERS 黑猫入场] 宽景。一只黑猫从画面左边缘沿气垫船舷板走入，跳上空着的驾驶座。手机向左摇过去找它。
7-10 秒：[CAUSE 起因] 黑猫落到油门踏板旁的甲板上，然后跳起落在踏板上，将踏板猛踩下去。推近到黑猫。
10-14 秒：[FAN ROARS 风机轰鸣] 手机拉到宽景。螺旋桨变成一片模糊。风把西班牙苔压平，吹飞游客的草帽。气垫船向左侧冲出去，吊床猛地绷紧。
14-18 秒：[STRETCH 拉伸] 宽景，手机随着船向左摇。吊床像橡皮筋一样在护网罩和树干之间被拉得又长又细，男子仍在中间熟睡。
18-22 秒：[SLINGSHOT 弹弓发射] 绳结从秃柏上滑脱。吊床像弹弓一样把他发射出去，靴子交叉着，飞过气垫船和树梢。手机猛地摇向灰白色的天空。
22-26 秒：[BOAT ALONE 船孤行] 手机摇回到水面，宽景：无人驾驶的气垫船绕过一座小岛，驶回栈道方向，黑猫仍在踏板上。
26-30 秒：[PAYOFF 收尾] 宽景。他从天上掉下来跌进驾驶座，坐直身子，帽子仍遮着眼睛。船体下沉溅起水花。他继续打鼾。黑猫爬到他的腿上，气垫船滑过栈道。

[风格与质量增强]
具有真实重量的连贯物理效果、水花飞溅、稳定的角色和服装、手机视频的画面质感。无字幕。无屏幕文字。无背景音乐。

焦糖棕、暗玫粉、杏橙色、奶油黄、柔和的枫叶红、温暖象牙白，以及淡紫灰色的阴影。使用柔和、低饱和度的午后光线。不得使用霓虹色或刺眼的黑色。

RYOBIYORI
No. [编号] / [年份]

使用细腻、低调深棕色的字体。

所有文字、标签、和纸胶带与装饰元素必须完全位于右半部分之内。左半部分只能包含原创生成的写实目的地场景。绝不复用或修改现有的照片。

4:5 竖向肖像，精确的 50/50 左右构图，左侧为写实生成的目的地场景，右侧为水彩旅行手账插画，超高清。

[风格 + 镜头 + 氛围]
由一名旁观者在阿拉巴马州乡村水库的红色黏土岸边用手…

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]
Raw vertical smartphone video filmed by a bystander on the red clay bank of a rural Alabama reservoir, one continuous 30-second handheld take. Strong hand shake, clumsy digital zooms, hazy midday sun. Blurred cattails and barbed wire stay bottom left. The three men are loud, rowdy and never sit still. Real-time speed.

LOCKED SET: a huge round concrete spillway hole at the top, water always pouring over its whole rim into it, the lake flowing toward it; a fallen pine log from the right edge; one yellow rope from the tube to the log tip, the only thing holding it.
LOCKED CAST: three bare-chested men in denim bib overalls on the rim of one giant black tractor inner tube, beer cans in hand: a huge dark-bearded one on the left, a wiry one in a camo cap and mullet in the middle, a red-haired one in sunglasses on the right. A charcoal grill smokes mid-tube. One black cat, absent at second 0, walks in from the right edge at second 4.

Diegetic audio: falling water roar, grill sizzle, whooping, laughing, shouts in a Southern drawl, a heavy splash, the filmer's gasp.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]
[ref_image] is the first frame and also the exact last frame: the clip is a perfect loop. It locks the men, tube, grill, rope, log, spillway and framing.

[TIMELINE]
0-4s: [HOOK - PARTY] Opens exactly as [ref_image]. The men clink cans and roar laughing, the big one tears into a rib off the grill, the red-haired one flings water at him. The phone punches a wobbly zoom into the spillway, then back out.
4-8s: [CAT ENTERS] A black cat walks in from the right edge along the log, tail up. The phone swings right and zooms in on it. The wiry one jumps to his feet, bouncing the tube, and hollers "Well lookie there! Git on outta here, kitty!" while the others whoop and splash water at it.
8-11s: [SLASH] The cat stops over the taut yellow rope and with one claw swipe slices it clean through. Both ends whip away.
11-15s: [NO NO NO] Fast zoom out. The freed tube slides toward the hole. The men drop their cans, yell "No, no, no! Aw hell naw!" and paddle frantically backward with their hands.
15-20s: [SWALLOWED] The tube reaches the rim, spins once and plunges straight down INSIDE the spillway hole, the screaming men and the grill dropping down its throat until they vanish. The phone shakes hard.
20-23s: [SKY] As they vanish the phone zooms out fast and tilts up to the sky; the cat exits by the right edge. Empty sky; the tube enters at the frame's TOP edge and falls top to bottom, men and grill on it.
23-26s: [SPLASHDOWN] Tube, men and grill slam onto the water in their original spot. Huge splash.
26-30s: [LOOP] The splash settles fast and the men sit back down on the rim: same poses, same cans, the yellow rope tied taut to the log again, the cat gone, the phone in its starting position. The last frame is identical to [ref_image].

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]
Coherent water physics with real weight, stable faces and wardrobe. No subtitles, on-screen text or music.

And you are done! Hope you like it, waitng for yours in comments! 😎

[风格 + 镜头 + 氛围]
由一名旁观者在阿拉巴马州乡村水库的红色黏土岸边用手机竖屏拍摄的原始视频，单个连续 30 秒手持长镜头。强烈的手抖、笨拙的数字变焦、朦胧的正午阳光。模糊的香蒲和铁丝网始终位于左下角。三个男人大声喧闹、从不静止。实时速度。

锁定场景：顶部一个巨大的圆形混凝土溢洪道洞口，水持续从其整个边缘涌入，湖水流向洞口；一根倒下的松木从右边缘伸入；一条黄色绳子从浮圈连到松木尖端，是唯一固定它的东西。
锁定演员：三个光着上身的男人穿着牛仔背带工装裤，围坐在一个巨大的黑色拖拉机内胎边缘，手持啤酒罐：左边是一个留着深色大胡子的高大男人，中间是一个戴着迷彩帽、留着马尾辫的瘦削男人，右边是一个戴墨镜的红发男人。浮圈中央有一个炭火烤架在冒烟。一只黑猫在第 0 秒不在场，在第 4 秒从右边缘走入。

画内音：落水的轰鸣、烤架的滋滋声、欢呼、大笑、南方口音的叫喊、沉重的水花声、拍摄者的倒吸凉气。

[图像参考]
[ref_image] 是第一帧，也是完全相同的最后一帧：片段是一个完美的循环。它锁定了男人、浮圈、烤架、绳子、松木、溢洪道和构图。

[时间线]
0-4 秒：[HOOK - 派对] 画面与 [ref_image] 完全一致地开场。男人们碰罐大笑，高大的那个从烤架上撕下一根肋骨，红发的那个向他泼水。手机不稳定地推近变焦到溢洪道，然后再拉远。
4-8 秒：[CAT ENTERS] 一只黑猫从右边缘沿着松木走进来，尾巴翘起。手机向右摇并对其变焦。瘦削的那个跳起来，浮圈随之弹跳，喊道"Well lookie there! Git on outta here, kitty!"，同时其他人欢呼并向它泼水。
8-11 秒：[SLASH] 黑猫停在绷紧的黄绳上方，用爪子一挥将其干净利落地割断。两端弹开。
11-15 秒：[NO NO NO] 快速拉远。失去束缚的浮圈向洞口滑去。男人们扔掉啤酒罐，大喊"No, no, no! Aw hell naw!"，并用手疯狂向后划水。
15-20 秒：[SWALLOWED] 浮圈到达边缘，旋转一圈后直直坠入溢洪道洞内，尖叫的男人们和烤架沿着洞口掉落直至消失。手机剧烈抖动。
20-23 秒：[SKY] 在他们消失时，手机快速拉远并向上倾斜指向天空；黑猫从右边缘离开。空旷的天空；浮圈从画面顶部边缘进入，自上而下坠落，男人和烤架在浮圈上。
23-26 秒：[SPLASHDOWN] 浮圈、男人和烤架重重砸回他们原本位置的水面。巨大的水花。
26-30 秒：[LOOP] 水花迅速消散，男人们重新坐回边缘：同样的姿势、同样的啤酒罐、黄色绳子再次紧紧系在松木上、黑猫消失、手机回到起始位置。最后一帧与 [ref_image] 完全一致。

[风格与质量增强]
连贯的水物理效果，具有真实重量，稳定的面部和服装。没有字幕、屏幕文字或背景音乐。

Premium Editorial Poster Instructions

Each uploaded photo must be made into a separate, independent, premium editorial poster, and multiple photos must not be combined. Use a strict 3:4 vertical canvas. Split the canvas horizontally in the exact center: the upper half and the lower half each occupy 50% of the height, are equally wide, and equally high, with no alteration of proportion.

The upper half uses the original photo directly and must not be regenerated. Preserve the identity of the main subject, the human body or architectural structure, proportions, perspective, spatial relationships, texture, natural light and shadow, color, and environment in their entirety. Only slight cropping and restrained premium color grading are permitted; re-drawing the main subject, fictional light, HDR, excessive saturation, plastic texture, and fictional content are prohibited. When needing to adapt to the frame, only environmental areas such as sky, water surface, ground, walls, plants, or background can be extended.

The lower half extracts and reconstructs the "narrative core" of the photo: it can be a single primary subject, or a group of related elements that together embody the photo's identity, scale, action, o story relationship. Maintain its realistic, recognizable appearance, proportion, internal structure, texture, and relative position. Do not remove important related elements, and do not directly use rectangular photo cutouts. The reconstructed subject typically occupies 55%-80% of the width of the lower area. It should naturally extend based on the photo's primary direction and retain plausible ground, water lines, shadows, or softly dissipated edges to integrate into the background, avoiding a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Incorporate a narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or through the center of the subject, serving as a "critical window" between reality and editorial abstraction. The color of the window must be extracted from the original photo, and its orientation (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) chosen based on the overall narrative direction.

The subject must actively pass through the window: part of it is within the color field, and part enters the open negative space, naturally crossing the window's boundary to create occlusion, penetration, and spatial depth. The window is not a frame or a card; it must not fully enclose the subject. Only one primary window is allowed; multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, and drop shadows are prohibited.

Use a white, cool white, very light gray, or near-white background for the lower half, coordinated with the photo. Employ a restrained asymmetrical composition and abundant negative space to establish a three-tier hierarchy:

Reconstructed subject or narrative composition

Low-saturation geometric window

上半部分直接使用原始照片，不得重新生成。须完整保留主体的身份、人体或建筑结构、比例、透视、空间关系、纹理、自然光影、色彩和环境。仅允许轻微裁剪和克制的高级调色；禁止重绘主体、虚构光线、HDR、过度饱和、塑料质感和虚构内容。如需适配画面，只能延伸天空、水面、地面、墙壁、植物或背景等环境区域。

下半部分提取并重建照片的"叙事核心"：可以是单一主体，也可以是一组相关元素共同体现照片的身份、规模、动作或叙事关系。须保持其真实可辨的外观、比例、内部结构、纹理和相对位置。不得移除重要的相关元素，也不得直接使用矩形照片裁剪。重建主体的宽度通常占下半部分宽度的 55%-80%。它应根据照片的主要方向自然延展，并保留合理的地面、水线、阴影或柔和消散的边缘以融入背景，避免贴纸式或悬浮外观。

在主体背后或穿过主体中心处嵌入一个窄而低饱和度的几何色块，作为现实与编辑抽象之间的"关键窗口"。窗口颜色必须从原始照片中提取，其方向（水平、垂直或对角）根据整体叙事方向选择。

主体必须主动穿过窗口：部分位于色块之内，部分进入开放负空间，自然跨越窗口边界以形成遮挡、穿透和空间纵深。窗口不是画框或卡片，不得完全包裹主体。仅允许一个主要窗口；禁止使用多个色块、粗边框、圆角、强渐变和投影。

下半部分使用白色、冷白、极浅灰或近白背景，与照片协调。采用克制的非对称构图和大量负空间，以建立三层层次：

重建主体或叙事构图

低饱和度几何窗口

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a NEW 15-second Japanese action-comedy with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. Use the selected aspect ratio.

STORY
A buys ONE soda. The vending machine suddenly pours out hundreds of cans. A and B flee, but the rolling avalanche catches and buries them up to their shoulders. B calmly opens one can. End on A's familiar stunned face, holding the single can she bought.
REFERENCES
A = the black-haired character from @Image 1; voice timbre from @Audio 1.
B = the white-haired character from @Image 2; voice timbre from @Audio 2.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. References define identity and voice, not poses, backgrounds or scripts. Never merge identities or replay recorded words.

SCENE AND STYLE
Deserted sidewalk beside Shibuya Scramble Crossing at dusk. One human-scale vending machine stands screen-right, its lower retrieval opening facing camera. A stands beside it; B waits to her left. Payment is already complete.
Photorealistic Shibuya architecture, crossing stripes, pavement, machine, cans and lighting. A and B remain hand-drawn 2D anime with clean lines and cel shading, integrated with contact shadows and reflected light.
Rows of plain drink cans and selection buttons; no readable labels or logos.
PROP AND ACTION CONTINUITY
All cans are hand-sized metal cylinders, silver with a cyan band and pull tab. No liquid flood, foam, giant cans or shapeless metallic mass.
Every new can emerges from the SAME retrieval opening. The machine keeps its size and design.
Cans shoot out in a narrow stream, fan outward, bounce and roll into a ground-level avalanche that catches the pair.
A receives the FIRST can in her RIGHT hand and keeps that same unopened can through the final frame. She never presses the button a second time.
Only TWO characters; BOTH are caught. Keep their faces visible and bodies uninjured. Retain the settled pile around them between shots.
0.0-2.0s — JUST ONE DRINK
Open on a medium two-shot showing both characters, the selection button and the retrieval opening.
A presses ONE button with her left hand. At 0.2-1.1s, A says in Japanese {いっぽんだけ。}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1, with natural synchronized lips.
One can drops into the tray with an ordinary clunk. A picks it up with her right hand. B watches casually.
Finish the purchase by 2.0s; no walk-up or coin insertion.
(Light, brief instrumental everyday music.)
<Button click, one ordinary can clunk.>
2.0-4.5s — THE MACHINE WILL NOT STOP
Hold a clear three-quarter view including the machine, both characters and the ground.
Immediately after A takes her can, another drops, then several more. The clunks accelerate into a rapid mechanical rattle.
By approximately 2.8s, a continuous stream of cans bursts from the retrieval opening. It fans outward and becomes a rolling avalanche across the pavement.
The machine shudders but stays upright. A and B both react visibly: eyes widen, shoulders recoil, then they turn to flee.
Show the normal output turning into the avalanche without a concealing cut or smoke.
(The music cuts off when the rapid stream begins.)
<Accelerating metallic clunks, mechanical rattle, cascading cans.>

4.5-8.5s — RUNNING MAKES NO DIFFERENCE
Side tracking shot. Both characters run screen-left along the same sidewalk, away from the machine. A still grips her original can in her right hand.
The rolling mass follows behind them, catches their ankles and overtakes them. A dense tumble of cans piles around their legs and torsos.
At 4.7-6.7s, A gives one continuous frightened Japanese cry {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1.
At 5.0-7.0s, B joins with {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 2. Keep the two voices distinct even while overlapping.
They lose their footing and sink into the heap; keep their faces visible.
By 8.5s, both are immobilized up to their shoulders, side by side. Their voices have stopped.

Progress from running to overtaking to burial; no running loop.
8.5-10.5s — SILENCE AFTER THE AVALANCHE
Front medium two-shot. A is on the left, B on the right. Both heads and their raised hands emerge from the SAME settled heap of cans.
The machine's output stops. A few final cans roll down the pile; the metallic roar quickly fades.
A holds her original unopened can just above the heap and stares in disbelief.
B takes ONE loose can from the pile. Bodies remain naturally concealed, with coherent shoulders and arms.
<The last few cans clatter and settle, then faint street ambience.>
10.5-12.5s — THE TINY OPENING SOUND
Cut to a medium close-up of B, her face and the can held just below her chin.
Still buried, B calmly opens the pull tab once with a brief hand movement and synchronized sound.
<One crisp can-opening click and a short "psst.">
The "psst" is escaping gas, not a vocalization.
B's mouth stays closed. She looks quietly satisfied and holds the open can. No speech, drinking sequence or additional action.
Keep the pile visible around her shoulders. No music or comedy sting.
12.5-15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Cut to A's face, with cans around her shoulders and her original unopened can still visible at the lower frame edge.
Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression: wide eyes, small pupils, raised eyebrows, slightly parted lips held still.
Her gaze shifts once from the single can to the mountain around her, then settles forward.
Use a short controlled push-in and hold the final full second. No dialogue, scream or repeated mouth movements.
End directly on A's silent face.

OUTPUT RULES
Only A's opening sentence and the TWO assigned sustained cries. Each uses her own voice reference. No additional dialogue, narration, laughter, improvised vocal reactions or voice from the vending machine.
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermark, HUD or end card.
No extra people, duplicate characters, mixed identities, extra limbs, fused hands, costume changes, injuries or disappearing can pile.
Readable progression: purchase → overflow → escape → burial → tiny opening sound → stunned face. Each shot adds a development; no repetitive action loops.

以所选画幅比例，创建一个全新的 15 秒日语动作喜剧短片，要求对白与音效同步。

【故事】
A 买了一罐汽水。自动贩卖机突然喷涌出数百个易拉罐。A 与 B 仓皇逃跑，却被翻滚而来的罐头雪崩追及，埋至肩部。B 从容地打开一罐。结尾落在 A 那张熟悉的惊愕脸上，手中仍握着她买的那唯一一罐。
【参考】
A = 来自 @Image 1 的黑发角色；音色来自 @Audio 1。
B = 来自 @Image 2 的白发角色；音色来自 @Audio 2。
须精确保留五官、发型、服装、配饰、身材比例与参考美术风格。参考仅定义身份与音色，而非姿势、背景或台词。不得融合身份，也不得回放已录制的词句。

【场景与风格】
黄昏时分的涩谷十字路口旁空旷人行道。一台与人等高的自动贩卖机置于画面右侧，其下方取货口朝向镜头。A 立于机器旁；B 在她左侧等候。付款已经完成。
涩谷建筑、十字路口斑马线、地面、机器、易拉罐与光照均为照片级真实质感。A 与 B 保持手绘二维动画风格，线条干净，使用赛璐璐上色，并融入接触阴影与反射光。
成排的普通饮料罐与选货按钮；不可出现可辨认的标签或标志。
【道具与动作连续性】
所有易拉罐均为手掌大小的金属圆筒，银色配青色色带与拉环。不得出现液体喷涌、泡沫、巨型罐体或无定形金属块。
每一只新出现的易拉罐都必须从同一个取货口涌出。机器保持原有尺寸与外观。
易拉罐以细窄的流束喷出，呈扇形散开，弹跳并滚落成地面雪崩，将二人吞没。
A 用右手接住第一只罐，并在最后一帧前始终紧握这只未开启的罐。她不得再次按下按钮。
仅限两名角色；二人均被埋住。须保持面部可见、身体无伤。各镜头之间须保留已堆积的罐堆。
【0.0–2.0 秒——只买一罐】
以中景双人镜头开场，呈现两位角色、选货按钮与取货口。
A 用左手按下其中一个按钮。在 0.2–1.1 秒期间，A 用日语说 {いっぽんだけ。}，音色参考 @Audio 1，嘴唇自然同步。
一只易拉罐以普通的“咣当”声落入出货托盘。A 用右手将其拿起。B 在一旁随意观看。
须在 2.0 秒前完成购买动作；不出现走近或投币过程。
（轻快、短促的日常器乐背景音乐。）
<按钮点击声，一只易拉罐的普通咣当声。>

【2.0–4.5 秒——机器停不下来】
保持清晰的三分之三角度视野，纳入机器、两位角色与地面。
A 刚取走她的罐，另一只即落下，随后接连掉落更多。咣当声逐渐加速，演变为急促的机械哒哒声。
至约 2.8 秒，一股持续的易拉罐流从取货口喷涌而出，呈扇形散开，在地面上化作翻滚的雪崩。
机器颤抖但保持直立。A 与 B 均有明显反应：双目睁大、双肩一缩，随后转身奔逃。
须直接呈现正常出货转为雪崩的过程，不得用切换或烟雾进行遮挡。
（急促流束开始时，背景音乐立即切断。）
<加速的金属咣当声、机械哒哒声、罐体倾泻声。>

【4.5–8.5 秒——逃跑无济于事】
侧面跟踪镜头。两位角色沿同一条人行道向画面左侧奔跑，远离机器。A 的右手仍紧握最初那只罐。
翻滚的罐堆紧随其后，缠住她们脚踝并将其吞没。密集翻滚的罐体堆积至她们的腿部和躯干周围。
在 4.7–6.7 秒期间，A 发出一声持续的日语惊叫 {わーーーー！}，音色参考 @Audio 1。
在 5.0–7.0 秒期间，B 加入一声 {わーーーー！}，音色参考 @Audio 2。即使声音重叠，也须保持两种音色彼此分明。
二人失去平衡，沉入罐堆之中；保持面部可见。
至 8.5 秒，二人并肩被埋至肩部，无法动弹。喊声停止。

须呈现由奔逃、被追上到被埋的递进过程；不得出现奔跑循环。
【8.5–10.5 秒——雪崩后的沉寂】
正面中景双人镜头。A 在左，B 在右。两人的头与举起的双手从同一堆已稳定的易拉罐中露出。
机器停止出货。几只最后的罐体沿罐堆滚落；金属轰鸣声迅速消退。
A 将最初那只未开启的罐举在罐堆上方，难以置信地凝视。
B 从罐堆中取出一只松散的罐。身体自然隐没于罐中，肩部与手臂保持连贯一致。
<最后几只易拉罐叮当作响并稳定下来，随后是隐约的街景环境音。>

【10.5–12.5 秒——那声轻微的开罐声】
切至 B 的中近景镜头，包含她的脸与举在下颌附近的易拉罐。
B 仍被埋住，以一个简短的手部动作从容地一次性拉开拉环，并配有同步音效。
<一声清脆的开罐“咔哒”声与一段短促的“嘶——”声。>
“嘶——”声为气体逸出的声音，而非人声。
B 双唇紧闭。她神情安静满足，并握着已开启的罐。不得出现台词、喝饮动作或其他附加行为。
须保持其肩部周围的罐堆可见。不得使用音乐或喜剧配乐音效。
【12.5–15.0 秒——那张熟悉的脸】
切至 A 的面部镜头，肩部四周环绕易拉罐，画面下沿边仍可见她最初那只未开启的罐。
呈现她标志性的、无法理解的惊愕神态：眼睛睁大、双眉上抬、瞳孔缩小、双唇轻启并保持不动。
她的视线由那只孤零零的罐移向周围的“罐山”一次，随后定格向前。
使用一次短促克制的推镜头，并保持最后一秒定格。不得有台词、尖叫或重复的嘴部动作。
画面直接结束在 A 沉默的脸上。

【输出规则】
仅可出现 A 的那句开场台词与两句指定的持续喊声。各角色使用其对应的音色参考。不得加入额外的台词、旁白、笑声、即兴的人声反应或来自自动贩卖机的声音。
不得出现字幕、说明文字、对话气泡、可辨认文字、标志、水印、HUD 及片尾画面。
不得出现额外人物、重复角色、身份混杂、多余肢体、手部融合、服装变化、受伤或消失的罐堆。
可读的剧情递进：购买 → 溢出 → 逃跑 → 埋住 → 轻微的开罐声 → 惊愕的脸。每个镜头都须带来新进展；不得出现重复的动作循环。

风格

建筑旅行海报 × 针织微缩立体模型 × 手工织物艺术 × 毛绒毛线世界 × 精致的编辑插画。

CUT DISCIPLINE: 6 distinct hard cuts with explicit timestamps --- do not render as one continuous single take. Character keeps moving; no idle victory pose until final 1.5 seconds. 

WORLD: Creaky interior and porch of a decaying rural Javanese wooden Joglo plantation house at 3:00 AM, torrential monsoon rain hammering the roof, thick incense (kemenyan) smoke hanging in the damp air. 

CHARACTER: Maya @[Image 1](image_1) Image, 24-year-old Javanese woman, wet dark hair framing her face, faded cream kebaya and dark batik sarong, holding a flickering brass kerosene lamp, skin covered in cold sweat. 

CINEMATIC HORROR SHOT DESIGN (6 Filmic Cuts with Expressions): 
• SHOT 1 (0–2s | Macro Detail): Extreme macro close-up of a smoldering ceramic incense burner (pedupaan); grey kemenyan smoke curls past the sinister carved wooden face of an antique shadow puppet (wayang kulit). 
• SHOT 2 (2–4s | Human Action): Medium shot as Maya walks slowly down the dark wooden hallway, her bare feet creaking on warped floorboards, her trembling hand shielding the flickering kerosene lamp flame from a cold draft. 
• SHOT 3 (4–6s | Micro-Acting Close-Up): Tight close-up on Maya's terrified face. Her jaw trembles; her pupils dilate in pure horror as she hears a faint rhythmic scraping sound from the ceiling above. A single cold tear tracks down her cheek. 
• SHOT 4 (6–9s | Environmental Scale): Extreme wide low-angle shot as a sudden blinding lightning flash illuminates the entire rotting Joglo exterior, surrounded by towering ancient banyan trees with tangled hanging roots whipping in the storm. 
• SHOT 5 (9–12s | Creeping Tracking): Slow, low Steadicam tracking shot moving behind Maya as she reaches the open doorway; the wind suddenly blows out her kerosene lamp, plunging the frame into suffocating darkness except for cold moonlight. 
• SHOT 6 (12–15s | Horror Climax Frame): Sudden lightning strike illuminates the end of the hallway: a tall shrouded white figure (Pocong) @[Image 2](image_2) with blackened facial hollows stands motionless in the corner. Maya freezes in silent, gasping terror. Final frame holds 1.5s.

Wêneyekî pir rastîn ku bi kameraya dîjîtal a biçûk a destpêka salên 2000an hatiye kişandin, 4:3 asoyî. Referansê tenê ji bo parastina rû û berdewamiya heman karaktera jin a xeyalî bikar bîne. Por bi laçikeke bi gulik nixumandî ku ber bi paş ve hatiye kişandin, çend çîpên por derketine. Cil: fistanekî kevneşopî yê qat bi qat bi rengên qehweyî yên axê û şerabî, hirmetkeke hirî ya çinî li ser, gorên hirî di nav pêlavên plastîk de, destên wê ji kar hişk û ziwa bûne, tevnek biçûk a darîn li ser çokên wê. Dîmen: Devê konekî reş ê ji mûyê bizinan li zozanekî Zagrosê di nîvroyê de, giyayê kesk, bizinek girêdayî, çaydankeke metal li ser pelên agir, şopên berfê li ser lûtkeyên li paş, kursiyeke plastîk, komek betanî. Kêliyeke nû ya xwezayî û nehatiye amadekirin: Ji jêr ve hatiye kişandin, wekî ku kesek li ser giya li ber wê rûniştibe, nêzî metreyekê dûr. Ew di nîvê gotinê de ye û bi kesekî re diaxive ku li milê çep, li derveyî çarçoveyê ye, bi destekî mekoka tevnê girtiye, bi destê din îşaretan dike, rûyê wê aram e, qermiçokeke biçûk di navbera birûyên wê de, çîpek por ketiye devê wê. Serê bizinê dikeve quncikê çarçoveyê. Kamera: Dîmena kameraya dîjîtal a biçûk a kevn, xelekên ronahiyê yên sivik li dora keviyan ji ber tûjkirina zêde, keviyên binefşî li ser kenara ezmanê ronî, gerdiya sensora biçûk, rengên tewş û bêcan, hinekî nermiya wêneyên wê serdemê yên ku tarîx li ser wan hatiye nivîsandin, bê flaş. Kompozîsyona rasthatî: çokên wê ji çarçoveyê hatine birîn, keviya kon ji jor ve wêneyê dibire, li jêrê pir zêde giya heye. Ronahî û pozlama: Ronahiya tûj a nîvroyê, ezman hinekî zêde ronî û spî bûye, siya kûr di hundirê kon de li paş wê, siyên xurt di bin çav û pozê wê de, hinarkên wê ji bayê sor bûne, toz û têlên hiriyê li ser qumaşê. Estetîk: Rastiya arşîva malbatê, wek wêneyekî ku li ser kartek bîrê ya kevn hatibe dîtin, germ û ne xemilandî. Çermê rastîn, destên rastîn, qumaşê rastîn. Bi tu awayî: cilaya kovara National Geographic, rengdana sînemayî, paşxaneya şêlû ya profesyonel, portreya destkariyê ya bi poz û amadekirî, rotûş û xemilandina çerm, rengên bi ronahiya berfireh a zêde, sîmetrî, tiştên ji bo dîmenê hatine danîn, an laşê bêkêmasî yê zekaya çêkirî tune be.

核心概念

创作一幅温暖、俏皮的编辑风插画，灵感来自目的地的氛围、色彩、气息与视觉特征。将整个场景浓缩为一个迷人的手绘瞬间，采用简洁、绘本式的构图。

主要主体

刻画一个小巧可爱的通用插画小角色，使其自然地与目的地环境互动。角色应拥有简单的圆脸、小而有表现力的眼睛、淡淡的腮红，以及放松自然的身体姿态。

根据 [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] 自动选择合适的服装、配饰、姿势与周围元素，同时保持角色完全原创且无法被识别。

场景

使用少量可识别的、源自目的地的元素——建筑、风景、花卉、地方物件、交通工具、食物或文化细节——构建极简的环境。

不要让构图过于拥挤。只使用传达地点信息所必需的最强视觉元素。

手绘童书插画 × 柔和的编辑风明信片 × 蜡笔与水粉插画。

保持背景以暖调的米白/奶油色为主，并留出充足的负空间。仅在能提升构图的位置，加入少量细腻的线条、小标记、云朵、树叶或动态笔触。

最终美学

一张迷人的手作旅行明信片，呈现亲密、俏皮、温暖且艺术的感觉——更像来自目的地的一幅小小插画记忆，而非对照片的字面再现。

H&M — “NEW UNIFORM” I researched H&M’s current brand/visual system first. The strongest identifiable elements are H&M red + black/white, a bold fashion-led typographic system, dramatic in-the-moment photography, and H&M’s own type family. H&M’s published style guide specifically emphasizes dramatic contrast, captivating in-the-moment/action photography, while its typography system uses IBM Plex Sans for supporting copy and a condensed headline face for impact. H&M also maintains proprietary fonts including HMSans, HMSerif, HM Amperserif and HMMove. So unlike the MANGO direction, this should be more energetic, graphic, youthful and high-contrast rather than Mediterranean/minimal. ⸻ PROMPT — H&M “NEW UNIFORM” FORMAT Ultra-Premium H&M Fashion SMM Promotional Poster Vertical 4:5 Instagram Hero Creative Global Fashion Retail Campaign Contemporary Fashion Advertising Commercial Fashion Graphic Design Agency-Level Art Direction Behance Front Page Quality 8K UHD Hyper-Realistic Fashion × Graphic Design × Street Culture Fusion High-Impact Visual Communication Zero AI Slop Zero Generic Fast-Fashion Advertising Zero Catalogue Aesthetic Zero Luxury-Copycat Aesthetic ⸻ CORE STRATEGY This is not simply a clothing advertisement. This is H&M turned into a visual statement. The campaign should communicate: fashion moves fast. culture moves faster. H&M should feel: accessible + expressive + contemporary + youthful + global + confident. The visual language should combine: H&M fashion campaign × editorial magazine × street-culture poster × high-fashion graphic design × digital-first social advertising The result should feel unmistakably H&M, not Zara, Mango, COS or a generic luxury fashion brand. H&M’s own published style direction emphasizes dramatic contrast and in-the-moment photography, so the photography should feel alive rather than static. ⸻ CAMPAIGN IDEA “NEW UNIFORM” Forget traditional uniforms. This is: THE UNIFORM OF NOW. The clothes represent the constantly changing identity of a new generation. One day: minimal. Next day: street. Next: tailored. Next: experimental. H&M becomes the wardrobe that keeps up. The campaign message: THE UNIFORM CHANGES. YOU DON’T HAVE TO. ⸻ MASTER VISUAL Create an enormous typographic structure reading: H&M The typography should occupy approximately 60–70% of the entire composition. But unlike the MANGO concept, the H&M typography should feel: bold compressed graphic energetic slightly disruptive The giant H&M lettering can be: partially cropped, stacked, repeated, layered, hidden behind the model, intersected by red graphic blocks, cut by diagonal photographic frames, and pushed beyond the canvas. The typography should feel like a physical poster installation, not simple text. ⸻ HERO SUBJECT Young female fashion model. Contemporary global fashion appearance. Natural skin texture. Strong expressive face. Minimal but polished makeup. Confident expression. No artificial influencer smile. No exaggerated luxury pose. The model should feel like someone who actually belongs in the city. Youthful. Self-assured. Energetic. Culturally aware. ⸻ WARDROBE Create a contemporary H&M fashion look. HERO LOOK Oversized black leather-effect bomber jacket. Crisp white fitted tank. Relaxed wide-leg grey trousers. Chunky black footwear. Small silver jewelry. Structured mini shoulder bag. Subtle red accessory detail. Layered styling. The clothing should feel: accessible fashion elevated through styling. Not couture. Not runway costume. Not quiet luxury. Not excessive branding. The clothes should look genuinely wearable. ⸻ POSE / MOVEMENT The model is captured mid-stride. One foot forward. Jacket moving naturally. Hair slightly moving. Body turned approximately 15 degrees. Direct eye contact. One hand adjusting the jacket. Other hand relaxed. The image should feel like a moment captured rather than a pose performed. Sharp moment. Natural movement. Hard directional light. Deep shadows. Bright whites. Saturated H&M red. Natural skin. Realistic fabric. Subtle motion in clothing. H&M’s published style guide specifically calls for dramatic contrast and captivating in-the-moment imagery, with action shots as the primary photographic direction. ⸻ LIGHTING Large directional studio source. No soft luxury haze. No excessive bloom. No artificial neon. ⸻ CAMERA ARRI Alexa Mini LF 50mm fashion/editorial lens Slightly low camera angle. Full-body composition. Fast-fashion campaign energy. Moderate depth of field. Extremely sharp clothing texture. Natural movement. High dynamic range. Brand recognition should come from: red / black / white bold condensed typography dramatic in-motion photography accessible contemporary styling graphic campaign language youthful global fashion energy strong commercial communication Do not make it resemble: ZARA’s restrained editorial minimalism. A high-impact H&M campaign where typography, movement, fashion and graphic design become one visual system. Create a premium 3:4 vertical editorial travel-memory poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire artwork creatively from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] alone. No reference image required.

COMPOSITION
Divide the poster into two perfectly equal horizontal halves with no gap.

TOP HALF — CINEMATIC PHOTOGRAPH
Create a wide horizontal, photorealistic travel photograph representing [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Automatically choose the most meaningful subject, architecture, landscape, or moment associated with the destination.

The image must feel like an authentic editorial photograph: natural perspective, realistic lighting, subtle color grading, strong central subject, cinematic atmosphere, and believable environmental details.

BOTTOM HALF — OPEN-BOOK JOURNAL
Create one fully opened horizontal hardcover photography book centered in the lower half, viewed almost from above with slight realistic perspective.

The book should occupy roughly 86% of the lower-half width. The spine must sit exactly in the center, with perfectly equal left and right pages. Show realistic paper edges, thickness, spine curvature, soft shadows, and premium tactile paper.

LEFT PAGE
Fill the entire left page with one dominant color naturally extracted from the destination’s visual identity.

Place a smaller horizontal landscape photograph at the center of the page, showing the same destination or subject from the upper scene. Keep it rectangular, clean, and surrounded by an even generous border.

RIGHT PAGE
Use warm ivory paper with abundant negative space.

At the upper center, add one elegant 3–5 word ALL-CAPS English title inspired by the mood of the destination. Use small black typewriter-style serif lettering with subtle letter spacing.

Below it, place ONE perfectly upright vintage vertical postage stamp. Give it a cream perforated border, subtle paper texture, and a delicate shadow.

Inside the stamp, do not simply reproduce the main photograph. Instead, reinterpret 2–4 recognizable elements from the destination as a playful editorial illustration using bold hand-drawn black outlines, simplified shapes, and ONE bright accent color drawn from the scene.

Below the stamp, add two short centered lines of gentle poetic English text.

BACKGROUND
Outside the open book, create a softly blurred continuation of the destination’s environment. Preserve only its general colors, light, and atmosphere while keeping individual objects indistinct.

STYLE
Cinematic travel photography × contemporary photography monograph × open-book visual diary × vintage postage illustration × minimalist editorial design.

Warm, quiet, sophisticated, tactile, intimate, and collectible.

PRIORITIES
Perfect 50/50 top-bottom division → perfectly centered book spine → equal pages → strong horizontal photography → intact upright stamp → generous negative space.

Avoid portrait-oriented photo panels, blurred side bars, stretched imagery, invented landmarks, distorted architecture, uneven pages, tilted or cropped books, multiple stamps, excessive decoration, clutter, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or unnecessary typography.

FORMAT
3:4 vertical, two equal halves, premium editorial photography, realistic open-book construction, refined typography, cohesive travel-journal aesthetic.

为 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 创作一张高级感 3:4 竖版编辑风旅行回忆海报。

仅文生图 —— 仅依据 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 创意生成整幅作品。无需参考图。

构图
将海报平均分为上下完全相等的两部分，中间无缝隙。

上半部分 —— 电影感照片
创作一张宽幅水平、超写实的旅行照片，代表 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题]。自动选择与该地相关的最有意义的拍摄对象、建筑、风景或瞬间。

图像必须呈现真实编辑照片的感觉：自然透视、真实光线、细腻的调色、强烈的主体、电影感氛围，以及可信的环境细节。

下半部分 —— 翻开的日记本
在画面下半部中央放置一本完全展开的横向精装摄影集，视角近乎俯视，带轻微的真实透视感。

书籍宽度约占下半部分的 86%。书脊必须严格居中，左右页完全对称。展现真实的纸张边缘、厚度、书脊弧度、柔和阴影与高级触感纸张。

左页
用从目的地视觉特征中自然提取的单一主色填满整页。

在页面中央放置一张较小的横向风景照片，展示与上部场景相同的地点或主体。保持感同尺寸矩形、干净，并被均匀、宽裕的留白环绕。

右页
使用温润的象牙色纸张，留有大量负空间。

在上方正中位置，加入一行优雅的、3–5 个词的英文 ALL-CAPS 大写标题，灵感来自目的地的氛围。使用小型黑色打字机风格衬线字体，并带有细微字距。

其下方放置一枚完美正立的复古竖版邮票。带有米色齿孔边框、细微的纸张纹理和柔和的阴影。

邮票内部不要简单复刻主照片，而是用粗犷的手绘黑色轮廓、简化的形状，以及从场景中提取的 ONE 种亮色点缀，将目的地的 2–4 个可识别元素重新演绎为俏皮的编辑插画。

邮票下方添加两行短小居中的温和诗意英文。

背景
在翻开的书本之外，营造目的地的环境柔和虚化延伸。仅保留其整体色彩、光线与氛围，使单个物体保持模糊不清。

风格
cinematic travel photography × contemporary photography monograph × open-book visual diary × vintage postage illustration × minimalist editorial design。

温润、静谧、精致、有触感、亲密且具收藏感。

优先级
完美的 50/50 上下分割 → 完美居中的书脊 → 左右页对称 → 强烈的横向摄影感 → 完整正立的邮票 → 充裕的负空间。

避免竖版照片面板、模糊的侧边栏、拉伸的画面、虚构的地标、扭曲的建筑、不对称的页面、倾斜或裁切的书本、多枚邮票、过度装饰、杂乱堆砌、Logo、水印、UI 元素或多余的文字。

格式
3:4 竖版，上下等分，高级编辑摄影，真实的翻书结构，精致的字体，和谐统一的旅行日记美学。
